title: H3 + LTX: swap to the lightx2v turbo LoRA at 6 steps, and ship true-RGB sampling previews
description:
MERGED SCOPE 2026-08-09 20:20Z. Started as the preview card; the H3 LoRA swap joined it because both land in the SAME two H3 graphs and the same raw->API conversion pass, so splitting them would give two cards ownership of one file.

Fabio, 2026-08-09, bench-verified. Both video models preview as latent2rgb colour blobs today. Two tiny VAEs fix that, and the LTX half is a rewire of a node we ALREADY ship.

LTX (SHIP, decided by Fabio after a live bench run): LTX2SamplingPreviewOverride is already in ltx_i2v_t2v.json / ltx_i2v_t2v_int8.json (node 366) and we feed its `vae` input the FULL video VAE. That input is a mode switch, not a decoder: ltxv_nodes.py:949-956 sets taeltx=True only when vae.first_stage_model.__class__.__name__ == TAEHV, otherwise WrappedPreviewer falls back to latent_rgb_factors - which IS the blocky preview. Feed it madebyollin taeltx2_3.safetensors via a plain VAELoader (comfy/sd.py:868 detects TAEHV from decoder.22.bias) and previews become real frames at real playback speed. Trade: the node NULLS latent_upscale_model on the TAEHV path, so sharp-but-blocky becomes soft-but-real. Fabio ships it anyway because the SPEED is finally correct - the old preview played back at a flash speed that misrepresented the video.

H3 (ship): H3 has no core previewer path at all - MiniMaxH3Video/MiniMaxH3AV set no taesd_decoder_name, taeh3 is not in latent_preview.VIDEO_TAES, and core TAESD cannot load it (Decoder width is hardcoded 64; taeh3 is 96/256-wide). The only route is KJNodes ModelPreviewOverrideKJ + its tiny_vae combo, reading models/vae_approx. ALREADY SHIPPED AND PINNED - comfyui-kjnodes is in dev_configs/node_lock.json, so no engine work.

USE madebyollin taeh3, NOT Kijai taeh3. Kijai/MiniMax-H3-TAE is a 2D decoder-only TAE (81 tensors, keys 1.bias.., 96-wide) - decode_video returns one image per LATENT frame, so a 3s clip previews as 19 frames and plays ~4x fast. madebyollin/taehv taeh3.safetensors (128 tensors, encoder.*+decoder.*, 256-wide, fp16) does the 4:1 temporal upsample and plays correctly. Kijai own README says the same and points at ollin.

WIDGETS, measured not guessed: preview_frames = the clip FRAME COUNT (our MpiH3Length `frames` output, the same wire feeding the H3 node length), preview_fps = 24. Fabio proved this on the bench after preview_fps=6 and preview_frames=10 both produced wrong playback. max_resolution 1024, jpeg_quality 80, suppress_default_preview false so core latent2rgb stays as fallback. The node `vae` input is IGNORED on H3 - it is only read inside the is_ltx branch.

COST, accepted by Fabio: ~5s on a 3s 864x480 clip. _tiny_vae_decode_to_pil runs INLINE in the sampler callback each step; JPEG/WebP/NVENC encode is on a background thread.

APP-SIDE WORK (H3 only): ModelPreviewOverrideKJ does NOT use the core ProgressBar. It base64s frames onto a custom WS event, PromptServer.send_sync(kj_preview_override, payload, client_id), addressed to the submitting client - which is us. comfyController.js already posts client_id (1551) and connects with the same id (904), so the frames arrive and nothing decodes them. Add a branch beside the binary-frame path (804-818) turning payload.image into a blob URL on the existing preview:frame bus. ~15 lines. The LTX node needs NONE of this - its callback ends in pbar.update_absolute, the standard channel we already render.

DEPS - NEITHER WEIGHT IS A DEPENDENCY YET. taeltx2_3.safetensors 23531296 bytes sha256 f0773b4e3e57318e6aa4dd4a35e1d16213a5f160fbc0376163f06888bbcbe246, loaded by VAELoader so it lives in vae/ NOT vae_approx/. taeh3 (ollin) 22709752 bytes sha256 4fd022bfcab08772fe0536b17ea1a3bbb5625be11e397868d1c5d891863d4c13, read via folder_paths vae_approx so it lives in vae_approx/ beside taesdxl/taef1/taef2 - and it wants a filename without the _ollin A/B suffix. Both madebyollin/taehv, Apache-2.0, no territory bar. Both need an R2 upload; 22MB each, trivial. Add to both LTX tiers (they share the graph) and both H3 DiTs.

STATE ON DISK: comfy_workflows/raw/ltx_i2v_t2v_template.json is ALREADY modified in the working tree - Fabio exported the rewired graph from the bench. The API graphs are untouched, so the raw export must go through the converter, and per memory tool_comfy_schema_gate_before_workflow_sync that conversion runs against the ENGINE on 48188, never the bench on 8188 (the bench runs ahead, 0.30.2 vs 0.30.0, and has silently shifted a widget before). Bench-only side effect to leave alone: G:/ComfyUi/ComfyUI/extra_model_paths.yaml gained a vae_approx: vae_approx/ line (backup .bak beside it) because the bench had no mapping for that folder.

=== LORA SWAP (Fabio, after a full bench A/B, 2026-08-09) ===
The larry v4_step600_ema LoRA we shipped this morning in MPI-505 is NOT ACTUALLY A SPEED-UP: Fabio measured it at close to no-LoRA timing. lightx2v minimax_h3_fl2v_lightx2v_turbo_4step_v0.1_comfy IS one - 105s -> 87.77s on the same clip. SHIP IT INSTEAD.

Settings, all measured not guessed: strength 0.75 (at 1.0 the AUDIO suffers too much - audio degrades before the picture does on this model), 6 steps (4 destroys the sound outright), and the two-stage split at 3+3 also looks good. The strengths are not comparable between the two LoRAs anyway - lightx2v bakes alpha/r=0.125 into lora_B, per its own safetensors metadata.

Both LoRAs are pure diffusion_model weights (416 tensors each, zero text-encoder keys), so strength_clip is a no-op on both. The MpiLoraModelClip gate stays as-is: its both-zero short-circuit is what makes turbo-off free.

R2 IS A DELETE-AND-REPLACE, AND THAT IS SAFE HERE: minimax-h3-turbo-lora entered the tree TODAY in 0b15f342 and the newest tag is v1.3.1, so no released build ever referenced it. git tag --contains 0b15f342 is empty. No user has it on disk, so the MPI-470/466 rule about never deleting a dep entry (the orphan sweep reads DEPS, so a deleted entry strands the weight forever) does not bite - there is nothing on any user disk to strand.

Fabio exported both H3 graphs from the bench. Diff vs HEAD is exactly: ModelPreviewOverrideKJ + 2 GetNodes added, BasicScheduler 8 -> 6 steps, MpiInt split 4 -> 3, MpiLoraModelClip lora_name swapped, MpiMath gate 1.0 -> 0.75. One artifact to undo before converting: fl2va node 320 MpiStageLatents flipped is_preview false -> true (bench state). It is injected at runtime as Video_Latent.is_preview (commandExecutor.js:673) so it is functionally moot, but the committed graph should stay false.
